name: Lyo.Email
tagline: Provider-neutral email contracts, request builder, and send pipeline. Register `Lyo.Email.Smtp` or `Lyo.Email.SendGrid` to send.
description: Provider-neutral email contracts, request builder, and send pipeline. `EmailRequest` is the message both providers send. `EmailServiceBase` applies the default From, attachment and bulk limits, metrics, logging, and events. Register `Lyo.Email.Smtp` or `Lyo.Email.SendGrid` to send. This package does not reference a mail SDK.
features: **EmailRequest.** Sender, `EmailAddress` recipients, subject, text and HTML bodies, attachments, reply-to, headers, and priority.
**EmailRequestBuilder.** Fluent helper. `Build()` returns an `EmailRequest`. An omitted display name is stored as the address.
**From.** A builder From wins. The explicit from-address overload replaces it. `SendEmailAsync(EmailRequest)` does not write the default From onto the result when From was null.
**Limits.** Over `MaxAttachmentCountPerEmail` or `MaxBulkEmailLimit` throws `ArgumentOutsideRangeException` before send. An empty bulk list returns an empty result and does not connect.
**Cancellation.** A cancelled send returns a failed `EmailResult` with `EmailErrorCodes.OperationCancelled`. It does not throw. A cancelled connection probe throws `OperationCanceledException`.
**Attachments.** Bytes, streams, files, and ZIP helpers. `MetadataJson` stays on the request and is not sent.

sections.title: Which From address wins
sections.body: On the builder overloads, a From set on the builder wins. Passing a non-whitespace from address replaces it, and an omitted display name becomes that address. When the builder has no From, the service stamps `DefaultFromAddress` and `DefaultFromName` before send. `SendEmailAsync(EmailRequest)` does not stamp a default onto `EmailResult.Data` when From was null. A failed builder send still carries the From that was applied.

sections.title: Providers
sections.body: `Lyo.Email.Smtp` sends with MailKit. `Lyo.Email.SendGrid` sends with the Twilio SendGrid package. Hosts register one of those. This package does not register a sender.
